quests.hint: Sort the changes from the things that stayed the same.
quests.explanation: Opening on Mondays is one of the things that changed.
quests.textToSpeak: When the café changed hands in March, the new owners kept the old menu but raised prices slightly. They also stopped opening on Mondays, though the staff and the opening hours on other days stayed the same.
quests.statement: The café now opens every day, just as it did before.
quests.instruction: Is this statement True or False? You make the call.
quests.evidenceQuote: stopped opening on Mondays

quests.hint: Which items were replaced and which were kept?
quests.explanation: The sofa was replaced and the walls repainted, but the bookshelf stayed where it was.
quests.textToSpeak: Our flat looks different now. We replaced the sofa and repainted the walls, but the old bookshelf stayed exactly where it was, because my father built it and nobody wants to move it.
quests.statement: The bookshelf was one of the things they replaced.
quests.instruction: Is this statement True or False? You make the call.
quests.evidenceQuote: old bookshelf stayed exactly where it was

quests.hint: Which direction did the start time move?
quests.explanation: Later start times mean the day begins later, not earlier.
quests.textToSpeak: The school has a new principal this year, Mrs Fernandes, who introduced a shorter lunch break and later start times. Class sizes are the same as before, but sports now take place only on Fridays.
quests.statement: The school day now begins earlier than it used to.
quests.instruction: Is this statement True or False? You make the call.
quests.evidenceQuote: later start times

quests.hint: Match each group with its day and its room.
quests.explanation: Support staff attend on Wednesday in the annex.
quests.textToSpeak: The training is on Tuesday in the main hall for sales staff, and on Wednesday in the annex for support staff. Managers can choose either day, but they must sign up by Friday.
quests.statement: Support staff attend the training on Tuesday in the main hall.
quests.instruction: Is this statement True or False? You make the call.
quests.evidenceQuote: Wednesday in the annex for support staff

quests.hint: Match each appointment with its day and time.
quests.explanation: The vet is on Tuesday at ten. Monday afternoon is the dentist.
quests.textToSpeak: The dentist is at three on Monday, the vet is at ten on Tuesday, and I've booked the car service for Wednesday morning. Thursday is completely free, so I'll do the shopping then.
quests.statement: The vet appointment is on Monday afternoon at three.
quests.instruction: Is this statement True or False? You make the call.
quests.evidenceQuote: vet is at ten on Tuesday

quests.hint: Which details differ between the classes and which are shared?
quests.explanation: The days differ, but the departure time is the same for both.
quests.textToSpeak: Class 4B goes to the science museum on Thursday, and 4C goes on Friday. Both classes leave at nine sharp, and the coach picks them up from the school gate.
quests.statement: The two classes visit the museum on different days but set off at the same time.
quests.instruction: Is this statement True or False? You make the call.
quests.evidenceQuote: Thursday ... Friday ... leave at nine sharp

quests.hint: Has the owner done it, or is it only being considered?
quests.explanation: Soundproofing is only an idea at the moment.
quests.textToSpeak: The neighbours complained about the noise, so the bar closed its terrace at ten. Business dropped by a quarter, and the owner is now thinking of adding soundproofing so the terrace can stay open later.
quests.statement: The bar has already added soundproofing after the complaints.
quests.instruction: Is this statement True or False? You make the call.
quests.evidenceQuote: is now thinking of adding soundproofing

quests.hint: Follow the chain from the late supplier to the return of customers.
quests.explanation: The owner offered the discount because customers were let down.
quests.textToSpeak: Because the supplier was late, the shop opened without the new stock. Customers were disappointed, so the owner offered a small discount on the next visit, which brought most of them back the following week.
quests.statement: The discount was the owner's response to customers being disappointed.
quests.instruction: Is this statement True or False? You make the call.
quests.evidenceQuote: Customers were disappointed, so the owner offered a small discount

quests.hint: What caused the delay?
quests.explanation: The client's two changes caused it, not the team's planning.
quests.textToSpeak: The team missed the deadline because the client changed the brief twice. As a result, the manager renegotiated the contract, and the extra work is now being paid separately.
quests.statement: The team missed the deadline because of its own poor planning.
quests.instruction: Is this statement True or False? You make the call.
quests.evidenceQuote: because the client changed the brief twice

quests.hint: Put January, June and September in order.
quests.explanation: She covered the manager's duties from June and was promoted in September.
quests.textToSpeak: Anita started at the firm in January as an assistant, but after the manager left in June, she took over most of her duties. In September she was officially promoted, with a raise.
quests.statement: Anita was promoted after she'd already been doing the manager's work for a while.
quests.instruction: Is this statement True or False? You make the call.
quests.evidenceQuote: took over most of her duties ... officially promoted

quests.hint: What was the client's reaction to the delay?
quests.explanation: The client raised no objection to the Monday finish.
quests.textToSpeak: The project was supposed to be finished by Friday. Then the client asked for a small change on Wednesday, which nobody had planned for. We finished on Monday instead, and the client was fine with that.
quests.statement: The client accepted the late finish.
quests.instruction: Is this statement True or False? You make the call.
quests.evidenceQuote: finished on Monday instead, and the client was fine with that

quests.hint: Who really controls the budget?
quests.explanation: It is Sunil. Karim only handles invoices.
quests.textToSpeak: Everyone assumes Karim, who sits near the window, is in charge of the budget. In fact it's his colleague Sunil, but Karim handles the invoices, which is why people ask him first.
quests.statement: People wrongly believe that Karim manages the budget.
quests.instruction: Is this statement True or False? You make the call.
quests.evidenceQuote: In fact it's his colleague Sunil

quests.hint: How much of the wedding did the speaker miss?
quests.explanation: Only the start was missed. The ceremony and the rest were attended.
quests.textToSpeak: My train was late, so I missed the start of the wedding, but I caught the ceremony and everything afterwards. The bride said she hadn't even noticed I was missing until the speeches.
quests.statement: The speaker arrived late but didn't miss the whole event.
quests.instruction: Is this statement True or False? You make the call.
quests.evidenceQuote: missed the start of the wedding, but I caught the ceremony

quests.hint: What did the company cover and what did it leave out?
quests.explanation: Rooms were paid for. Meals were not.
quests.textToSpeak: The ferry was cancelled because of high winds, so passengers were put on the next sailing the following morning. The company paid for hotel rooms, but not for meals.
quests.statement: Passengers got accommodation but no food allowance.
quests.instruction: Is this statement True or False? You make the call.
quests.evidenceQuote: paid for hotel rooms, but not for meals

quests.hint: How did they actually reach the hotel?
quests.explanation: The connecting bus was missed, so a taxi took them to the hotel.
quests.textToSpeak: Our flight to Rome was delayed by three hours, so we missed the connecting bus to the hotel and took a taxi instead. The hotel refunded the taxi fare, but only after we showed the receipt.
quests.statement: They took a taxi to the hotel after missing the bus.
quests.instruction: Is this statement True or False? You make the call.
quests.evidenceQuote: missed the connecting bus to the hotel and took a taxi

quests.hint: Who lives on which level?
quests.explanation: The tenants are upstairs and the landlady is downstairs.
quests.textToSpeak: We rent the upstairs flat, and the landlady lives below us. She collects the rent in cash on the first of each month, and she doesn't allow pets, though she has two cats herself.
quests.statement: The tenants live on the ground floor below the landlady.
quests.instruction: Is this statement True or False? You make the call.
quests.evidenceQuote: rent the upstairs flat, and the landlady lives below us

quests.hint: Whose turn is it this week?
quests.explanation: The children are at their mother's house this week.
quests.textToSpeak: The kids alternate weeks between their mother's house and mine. This week they're with her, so I'll be free on Saturday, but next Saturday is football practice and a birthday party.
quests.statement: The speaker won't have the children this week.
quests.instruction: Is this statement True or False? You make the call.
quests.evidenceQuote: This week they're with her

quests.hint: Who cooks now, and who did before?
quests.explanation: The brother and the speaker alternate, taking over from the parents.
quests.textToSpeak: My parents used to do all the cooking, but since my father's shoulder operation, my brother and I take turns. Mum still does the shopping, and Dad supervises, mostly from the sofa.
quests.statement: The children now share the cooking.
quests.instruction: Is this statement True or False? You make the call.
quests.evidenceQuote: my brother and I take turns

quests.hint: What did the update do besides its intended job?
quests.explanation: It introduced a new fault with automatic logging out.
quests.textToSpeak: The software update was meant to fix the login bug, but it created a new problem. The app now logs you out after ten minutes. The developers have promised a patch, though they haven't said when.
quests.statement: The update fixed the login bug without causing other problems.
quests.instruction: Is this statement True or False? You make the call.
quests.evidenceQuote: created a new problem

quests.hint: What timeframe is given, and how firm is it?
quests.explanation: Five to seven working days is the expected window, not five days exactly.
quests.textToSpeak: Your refund has been approved, but it takes five to seven working days to reach your account. If it hasn't appeared after ten days, email us with your order number.
quests.statement: The refund will definitely reach the account within five days.
quests.instruction: Is this statement True or False? You make the call.
quests.evidenceQuote: five to seven working days

quests.hint: Did the improvement last?
quests.explanation: The green light lasted only a second, and the problem returned.
quests.textToSpeak: I restarted the router as you asked, but the light is still red. Then I tried a different cable, and the light went green for a second before turning red again. The engineer says he'll visit on Thursday.
quests.statement: Changing the cable solved the problem for good.
quests.instruction: Is this statement True or False? You make the call.
quests.evidenceQuote: light went green for a second before turning red again

quests.hint: What must residents do the night before?
quests.explanation: Vehicles have to be moved because the road closes on Saturday morning.
quests.textToSpeak: The street party is on Saturday from noon. The road will be closed to cars from eleven, so please move your vehicles the night before. Anyone who wants to bring food should sign up with Mrs Kapoor.
quests.statement: Residents need to move their cars before the day of the party.
quests.instruction: Is this statement True or False? You make the call.
quests.evidenceQuote: move your vehicles the night before

quests.hint: What changed and what stayed the same?
quests.explanation: The venue changed, but kick-off is still at three.
quests.textToSpeak: The football match on Sunday has been moved to the high school field because the main pitch is flooded. Kick-off is still at three, and tickets bought online remain valid.
quests.statement: The match will start at a different time from the original.
quests.instruction: Is this statement True or False? You make the call.
quests.evidenceQuote: Kick-off is still at three

quests.hint: How do the two years compare?
quests.explanation: Twice as much means this year was clearly higher.
quests.textToSpeak: The book sale raised twelve hundred pounds for the library, twice as much as last year. Volunteers say the cookery section sold out first, so they're planning to stock more next time.
quests.statement: This year's sale raised more money than last year's.
quests.instruction: Is this statement True or False? You make the call.
quests.evidenceQuote: twice as much as last year

quests.hint: How does the price of the substitute compare?
quests.explanation: The substitute costs slightly more, not less.
quests.textToSpeak: The pharmacy didn't have the usual tablets, so the pharmacist called my doctor, who suggested a similar brand. It costs slightly more, but the dose is the same.
quests.statement: The replacement medicine is cheaper than the usual one.
quests.instruction: Is this statement True or False? You make the call.
quests.evidenceQuote: costs slightly more

quests.hint: Which activities are banned and which are allowed?
quests.explanation: Running is off limits for now, while cycling is fine if pain-free.
quests.textToSpeak: The physiotherapist said my knee is healing, but I mustn't run for another month. I can swim and cycle, though, as long as it doesn't hurt. I'm going back for another check in three weeks.
quests.statement: The speaker may cycle provided it causes no pain.
quests.instruction: Is this statement True or False? You make the call.
quests.evidenceQuote: swim and cycle, though, as long as it doesn't hurt

quests.hint: Follow the appointment through its changes.
quests.explanation: Friday is the final date, after a cancellation slot became free.
quests.textToSpeak: I'd booked a check-up for Tuesday, but the surgery called to say the doctor was ill, so they moved it to the following Monday. Then I got a cancellation slot for Friday, so I took that.
quests.statement: The check-up is now on the following Monday.
quests.instruction: Is this statement True or False? You make the call.
quests.evidenceQuote: got a cancellation slot for Friday, so I took that

quests.hint: What is still missing after three years of success?
quests.explanation: Permanent permission from the council hasn't been granted.
quests.textToSpeak: The community garden began three years ago with just five volunteers and a borrowed spade. Today it feeds forty families, but the council still hasn't given permanent permission for the land.
quests.statement: The garden now has the council's permanent permission.
quests.instruction: Is this statement True or False? You make the call.
quests.evidenceQuote: still hasn't given permanent permission

quests.hint: Compare the speaker's expectations with the result.
quests.explanation: The speaker expected little, yet received full funding.
quests.textToSpeak: I applied for the scholarship without much hope, since hundreds of students apply. To my surprise, I got an interview, and a week later, the letter arrived confirming I'd won full funding.
quests.statement: The speaker won the scholarship despite low expectations.
quests.instruction: Is this statement True or False? You make the call.
quests.evidenceQuote: without much hope ... confirming I'd won full funding

quests.hint: What support does she have around her?
quests.explanation: Neighbours visit daily and her son calls every evening.
quests.textToSpeak: Rania's grandmother lives alone, but three neighbours check on her daily, and her son phones every evening. She refuses to move, saying the house holds all her memories.
quests.statement: Rania's grandmother is well supported despite living alone.
quests.instruction: Is this statement True or False? You make the call.
quests.evidenceQuote: three neighbours check on her daily, and her son phones every evening
